_meta.note: This file is a company-internal role requirements template. It is NOT sourced from public internet. Maintained by the HR team and updated each quarter. Do not share externally.

roles.title: Java Microservices Developer
roles.description: Designs and builds resilient backend microservices aligned to our internal service-mesh architecture. Engineers are expected to follow the company's internal API contract standards and use the approved tech stack.
roles.internal_notes: Role is mapped to Band 3. Candidates must clear the internal Java design-pattern assessment before deployment.

roles.title: Frontend Angular Developer
roles.description: Builds and maintains the company's customer-facing and internal Angular applications. Must adhere to the internal component library and design-system standards.
roles.internal_notes: All UI changes require UX sign-off. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) is a hard gate before release.

roles.title: Fullstack React Node Developer
roles.description: Delivers end-to-end features across the company's React frontends and Node.js BFF (Backend For Frontend) layer. Works closely with product and mobile teams.
roles.internal_notes: BFF layer follows internal API-gateway contract. All data mutations must go through the internal audit-log middleware.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Owns CI/CD pipeline infrastructure, cloud cost optimisation, and platform reliability within the company's multi-cloud environment (AWS primary, GCP secondary).
roles.internal_notes: Must hold or be working toward AWS SAA certification. All infra changes go through the internal change-advisory board (CAB) process.

roles.title: Python Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains the company's data platform: ingestion pipelines, transformation layers, and data-quality checks. Interfaces with the internal data-catalogue and governance tooling.
roles.internal_notes: All new pipelines must register metadata with the internal data-catalogue before going to production. GDPR tagging is mandatory for PII fields.

roles.title: AI/ML Engineer
roles.description: Designs, trains, and deploys ML models into the company's internal MLOps platform. Responsible for model lifecycle management, drift monitoring, and integration with product APIs.
roles.internal_notes: All models must pass the internal AI Ethics review board before production deployment. Explainability report (SHAP/LIME) is a mandatory deliverable.
